P1.1.text: Kadant Inc. - A Global Leader in Technology And Engineered Systems

P1.2.text: Kadant Inc. is a global supplier of high-value, engineered systems used in process industries worldwide.

P1.3.text: A Global Leader in Technology & Engineered Systems that Drive

P1.4.text: We are a global supplier of technologies and engineered systems that drive Sustainable Industrial Processing®. Our products and services play an integral role in enhancing efficiency, optimizing energy utilization, and maximizing productivity in process industries.

P1.5.text: Custom-engineered products, systems, and technologies used to enable fluid, power, and data transfer to optimize energy utilization, improve machine runnability, and enhance productivity.

P1.6.text: Machinery and engineered systems and components to help customers maximize the production of fiber-based, renewable products.

P1.7.text: Products and systems used to handle bulk and discrete materials for secondary processing.

P1.8.text: From paper and packaging to wood products, mining, food processing, and energy, Kadant delivers engineered systems and technologies purpose-built for the demands of global process industries. Explore how our expertise and solutions are put to work across the markets we serve.

P1.9.text: Explore our family of companies to learn how each one delivers specialized expertise and proven solutions to process industries around the world.

P1.10.text: Our products are designed to reduce waste, use resources more efficiently, and allow our customers to create more value with fewer inputs. We do this with integrity, a commitment to ethics, and responsible operations.

P1.11.text: Kadant's automation portfolio — illumen.X, PaperFront®, and Vayeron Asset Performance Monitoring — gives process industries the digital tools to optimize performance, predict equipment failures, and build data-driven operations from plant floor to enterprise.

P1.12.text: We work to envision the future and create value through discovering and applying innovations that address industrial processing challenges while extending our depth of technology.

P2.2.text: Our Flow Control segment consists of our Fluid Handling and Doctoring, Cleaning & Filtration product lines, delivering custom-engineered products, systems, and technologies that keep critical industrial and commercial processes running efficiently across packaging, tissue, food processing, metals, and other demanding sectors.

P2.3.text: Our brand portfolio carries a rich heritage of product innovation with well-known industry names including AES, Johnson, Lodding, Unaflex, and Vickery. Our primary products include rotary sealing devices, steam systems, expansion joints, doctor systems, roll and fabric cleaning devices, and filtration and fiber recovery systems. With deep application expertise and a proven track record, we help customers reduce energy consumption, improve machine runnability, and build long-term operational sustainability.

P2.5.text: Kadant’s fluid handling products and technologies are used to control the flow of fluids in process industries worldwide. These products include rotary joints and unions, expansion joints, condensate pumps, thermocompressors, desuperheaters, and direct steam injection heaters.

P2.6.text: Kadant’s wide range of doctoring, cleaning, and filtration systems and related consumables are used in process industries worldwide. These products include doctor blades and holders, roll cleaning blades and holders, spray nozzles, oscillating showers, and fabric and belt cleaning systems.

P2.7.text: DSTI is a leader in engineered fluid sealing and transfer solutions for rotating applications, serving a wide range of global industries. Its products include fluid rotary unions, electrical slip rings, and custom-engineered solutions designed and manufactured to meet the precise requirements of aerospace, defense, medical, semiconductor, machine tool, and industrial applications.

P3.2.text: For more than a century, Kadant has been delivering smart and efficient solutions to process industries.

P3.3.text: We are a global supplier of technologies and engineered systems that drive Sustainable Industrial Processing®. Our products and services play an integral role in enhancing efficiency, optimizing energy utilization, and maximizing productivity in process industries while helping our customers advance their sustainability initiatives with products that reduce waste or generate more yield with fewer inputs,

P1.1.text: Flowserve: Industrial Pumps, Valves, Seals & Actuators

P1.2.text: Flowserve moves, controls and protects the flow of materials in the world's most critical industries.

P1.3.text: We empower critical industries with extraordinary solutions.

P1.4.text: Flowserve manufactures and services pumps, valves, seals, and automation equipment that supports essential infrastructure around the world.

P1.5.text: Flowserve is committed to providing you with world-class support.

P1.6.text: Delivering a broader portfolio of engineered valve technologies, extensive nuclear valve solutions, and high‑quality OEM lifecycle services for the world’s most demanding, high‑consequence applications.

P1.7.text: Turbomachinery Lifecycle Expertise Now Part of Flowserve Services

P1.8.text: Introducing the LMX Cartridge Lip Seal for High‑Value Mixer Applications

P1.9.text: Flowserve has launched the LMX Cartridge Lip Seal — a carbon‑free, dry‑running sealing solution engineered specifically for demanding top‑entry mixers. Designed to help reduce contamination risk at its source, LMX delivers reliable performance when purity, precision and product integrity are on the line.

P1.10.text: Powering the Future of LNG Regasification

P1.11.text: Developed from decades of LNG expertise, the Cryogenic Submerged Motor Pump – High Pressure (HP) Series combines advanced cryogenic pumping technology with efficiency, reliability, and serviceability to help operators lower costs and improve long-term performance.

P1.12.text: Flowserve offers the world’s most comprehensive portfolio of flow control solutions. Our portfolio of pumps, valves, seals, actuation and instrumentation systems, and more is engineered to tackle our customers’ toughest challenges in fluid handling and control.

P1.13.text: Pumps ranging from standard to engineered, proven to handle your toughest

P1.14.text: Mechanical seal and sealing systems you can rely on for nearly any application.

P1.15.text: Valves engineered for performance and safety with precision control, optimized flow and fail-safe shut-off.

P1.16.text: The industry’s most complete range of actuators, positioners, controls, switches and accessories.

P1.17.text: The industry’s most energy-efficient solutions for SWRO desalination.

P1.18.text: We design reliable flow control equipment for use in a variety of industries including energy, nuclear power generation, chemical processing, and flood control facilities. Our application knowledge and technical expertise in flow control equipment enable us to help you with the toughest challenges you face in your application.

P1.19.text: Our solutions combine comprehensive flow control systems, innovative technology and world-wide aftermarket support to help optimize productivity, mitigate risks, and lower operating costs

P1.20.text: A complete flow control equipment monitoring solution using smart sensors, advanced analytics, and dedicated support to prevent failures and extend the life of your equipment.

P1.21.text: A system-wide analysis of your existing flow loops, tailored recommendations for energy savings opportunities, and solutions to optimize your system performance.

P2.2.text: Flowserve’s heritage brands, with over two centuries of innovation, provide reliable solutions in pumps, seals, valves, and IoT. Trusted globally for critical applications and backed by world-class service.

P3.2.text: Flowserve's application knowledge and technical expertise enable reliable flow control equipment you can trust in the most aggressive environments.

P3.3.text: At Flowserve you will find a deep application expertise that spans a variety of industries.

P3.4.text: Our application knowledge and technical expertise enable us to design reliable flow control equipment.

P3.5.text: Flowserve is unique in the flow management industry because of our deep application expertise that spans a variety of industries. We understand the challenges you face, whether you oversee deep-ocean production wells, chemical plants producing corrosive and toxic substances, or flood control facilities holding back the ocean. Our application knowledge and technical expertise enable us to design reliable flow control equipment you can trust even in the most aggressive environments.

P3.6.text: We provide a range of flow control solutions for a variety of industries.

P3.7.text: Power up with Flowserve. We provide powerful solutions that adhere to the most stringent quality and safety standards. Our high-quality products are designed to get you up and running quickly, and keep you up and running.
